from.place: Existence clause of the identity-extension unit map.

title: Existence of the identity scalar-extension unit map
statement:
theorem adicUnit_exists_data (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A]
    (φ : A →+* A) (hφ : φ = RingHom.id A)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (adicModuleRing X A)) ℤ) :
    ∃ f : adicChange X φ P ⟶ P, IsIso f ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : (adicConstantRing X A).obj.obj U)
        (m : (P.X p).val.obj U),
        (f.f p).val.app U (adicTensorSection X φ _ U s m) = s • m

proof.text: The identity coefficient homomorphism induces the identity on the constant ring sheaf. Thus restriction along it is isomorphic to the identity, by module maps that are identity on all sections. Lift the inverse of this restriction isomorphism through the sectionwise extension/restriction adjunction and module sheafification [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The resulting sheaf map sends s tensor m to s times m. Compose the scalar-extension unit with the restriction isomorphism to obtain its inverse, sending m to 1 tensor m. Injectivity of transposition reduces both inverse equations to the generator 1 tensor m, where the lift formula and one times m equals m prove them.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product, identity scalar extension; sheafification adjunction

proof.text: The two sheaf maps commute with the original differential: on s tensor m both paths send it to s times d(m), by linearity of d. Use the component isomorphisms to obtain an isomorphism between the changed complex [def-pur-change-of-rings-complex] and the original complex. Its hom is invertible and has exactly the asserted formula in every degree.
